name: freightlink-marketplace
description: FreightLink Marketplace - Full-stack logistics marketplace connecting shippers, brokers, carriers, and admins

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:user-web" "npm run dev:admin-panel"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=user-web && npm run build --workspace=admin-panel
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=user-web && npm run lint --workspace=admin-panel && npm run lint --workspace=backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=user-web && npm run typecheck --workspace=admin-panel && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend
